1. DMCA Copyright & Intellectual Property Policy

ApexMobile (https://apexmobile.example.com) respects the intellectual property rights of software developers and content creators and complies fully with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA).

Trademark & Attribution Notice

All third-party product names, operating system names (including Android and iOS), logos, and brands mentioned on this website are the property of their respective trademark owners. ApexMobile operates as an independent technical documentation and verification portal.

How to Submit a Formal DMCA Notice

If you believe that any material hosted or linked on ApexMobile infringes upon your copyright, please send a written DMCA notice to our designated agent at support@apexmobile.example.com containing:

  • Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed.
  • The exact URL(s) on https://apexmobile.example.com where the material is located.
  • Your full legal name, organization, mailing address, telephone number, and email address.
  • A statement made under penalty of perjury that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on the owner's behalf.

We review and act upon all valid copyright notices within 24 to 48 hours.
